detail.longDescription: Tech Analyst Increases Amazon Price Estimate Due to Surge in Consumer Engagement Fueled by AI # technology # artificialintelligence A tech analyst has raised Amazon’s price target, citing a surge in consumer engagement fueled by AI across shopping experiences. Learn how AI is reshaping product discovery, recommendations, and operations at Amazon, and what this could mean for value and growth.
